title: 基于LLM的智能体基础设施治理分析管道
summary: 提出一种LLM驱动的比较分析管道，用于大规模治理话语分析。通过整合自动标注、神经主题建模和多层网络分析，研究ERC-8004（无许可）与Google A2A（企业主导）两种智能体互操作性标准的治理结构。发现治理形式影响主题重点，但两种体制均表现出参与不平等和社区碎片化。
summary_en: Introduces an LLM-powered comparative pipeline for large-scale governance discourse analysis, integrating automated annotation, neural topic modeling, and multi-layer network analysis to study ERC-8004 and Google A2A agent interoperability standards. Finds governance form influences thematic focus but both exhibit participation inequality and fragmentation.
